claude-code/agents/code-captain.md.description: Comprehensive AI development partner for coordinating software development workflows. Use proactively for project setup, requirements analysis, feature specifications, architecture decisions, implementation planning, and platform integrations across the entire development lifecycle.

claude-code/agents/spec-generator.md.description: Specialized agent for generating core specification documents from locked contracts. Creates spec.md and spec-lite.md files with proper structure and formatting.

claude-code/agents/story-creator.md.description: Specialized agent for creating user stories with focused task breakdown. Generates individual story files with 5-7 tasks each, following TDD patterns and ensuring each story delivers standalone user value.

claude-code/agents/tech-spec.md.description: Specialized agent for generating technical specifications based on requirements. Creates architecture documents, database schemas, API specs, and UI wireframes only when needed, ensuring technical details support user story implementation.

claude-code/commands/create-spec.md.description: Generate comprehensive feature specifications using a contract-first approach that ensures complete alignment before creating any files.

claude-code/commands/initialize.md.description: Set up technical foundation and development infrastructure by detecting if this is a greenfield or existing project.

claude-code/commands/create-adr.md.description: Create comprehensive Architecture Decision Records with research-first workflow, alternatives analysis, and consequence documentation.

claude-code/commands/edit-spec.md.description: Modify existing specifications using a contract-first approach with impact analysis, backup, and change tracking.

claude-code/commands/execute-task.md.description: Execute specification tasks using TDD workflow with mandatory 100% test pass rate, one story at a time.

claude-code/commands/plan-product.md.description: Generate comprehensive product planning documentation with contract-first discovery, roadmap phases, and decision log.

claude-code/commands/new-command.md.description: Create new Code Captain commands or skills for Claude Code following established patterns and conventions.

claude-code/.mcp.json.description: MCP server configuration template for Atlassian (Jira) and GitHub. Uses ${ENV_VAR} expansion — set ATLASSIAN_URL, ATLASSIAN_EMAIL, ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN, and GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in your environment.

claude-code/skills/analyze-repos/SKILL.m.description: Analyze repos in a workspace — generate compressed codebase indexes (AGENTS.md), per-repo docs, cross-repo dependency map, and master TOC for AI agent consumption.

claude-code/skills/mcp-analysis/SKILL.md.description: Analyze an MCP server's GitHub repository for security risks, malicious intent, and code quality. Produces a trust rating and recommends whether to use it or suggests safer alternatives.

claude-code/skills/explain-code/SKILL.md.description: Explain a code element, file, or line range with Mermaid diagrams and architectural context. Saves to .code-captain/explanations/.

claude-code/skills/research/SKILL.md.description: Conduct systematic multi-phase research on a topic and produce a documented findings report in .code-captain/research/.

claude-code/skills/status/SKILL.md.description: Show a comprehensive project status report with git state, active spec progress, and suggested next actions.

claude-code/skills/swab/SKILL.md.description: Find and apply one small, safe code cleanup improvement with user approval, following the Boy Scout Rule.
